prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Reordering sign-in was helpful when placed after adoption selection (+5.5% won) or photo upload (+3.3% won), but placing it after the adoption certificate severely hurt performance (-22.4%).
Redesigns yielded mixed results: while several caused severe negative drops or no clear effect, specific redesigns like Stage Layout (+7.1% won) and Story Screen Scroll (+7.4% won) were helpful.
Desktop background notification prompts (+5.1% won), path helper hints (+3.5% won), sign-in clarifications (+9.9% won), and desktop visibility check screens (+8.0% won) were helpful, whereas sound cues, notification toggles/banners, overlay hints, and troubleshooter screens showed no clear effect.
Copy updates, incentives, and waiting screen progress or estimated time displays consistently showed no clear effect.
Predictions were frequently too high (over-optimistic) for tests that showed no clear effect, predicting gains up to +12.0%.
Predictions were too low for multiple winning tests, predicting negative or zero impact (-8.0% to +0.2%) on changes that ultimately won (+3.3% to +9.9%).

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Interactive Welcome Screen: Introduces a new finish screen (new_desktop_welcome) featuring an animated pet preview confirming desktop readiness before onboarding ends. (why: Finish step conversion drops to 69.6% and support received 3 tickets regarding pets not appearing on screen or confusion during initial launch.)
1: [finish, hint] Desktop Mascot Controls Quick Hint: Displays a clear hint component on the home_intro screen explaining basic desktop pet interaction commands. (why: 3 support emails reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet once on the desktop.)
2: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Stage Layout Redesign: Redesigns the introductory story screen using a stage layout featuring an animated mascot visual hero. (why: Choose path step has high mean duration (514s); stage layout redesigns previously proved highly successful (+7.1% on pick_friend).)
3: [choose_path, layout] Choose Path Stage Layout Redesign: Changes the choose_path screen layout to stage mode to highlight companion choices side-by-side with mascot visual elements. (why: Stage layout provided strong conversion wins (+7.1%) in earlier tests, addressing drop-offs on early decision screens.)
4: [adoption, new_screen] Custom Pet Early Visual Preview Screen: Adds a new screen (new_photo_preview) after photo upload to render an early preview of the custom pet before adoption certification. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet creation issues and adoption has the lowest step conversion rate (64.1%). Showing early preview reassures users.)
